decision question: May NFL.com/NFL statistics and gamebooks be collected and used in a commercial wagering research system?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: NFL.com Terms §1.3 limits service use to individual non-commercial informational purposes and prohibits systematic retrieval to compile databases without prior express written consent
missing information required: Written permission covering data fields storage model training gambling use redistribution retention geography and audits
decision blocked: Any NFL data ingestion or downstream publication

decision question: What authorized historical and real-time player/team data feed will supply results and participation?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: NFL.com exposes player stat pages and game centers
missing information required: Contract and documented scope for access completeness corrections history game identifiers and gambling use
decision blocked: Any historical backtest or live model feed

decision question: What is the authorized source for timestamped executable odds and closing prices?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: NFL schedule page supplies event context but not sportsbook prices
missing information required: Named licensed provider/operator; price, market, timestamp, limits, settlement and archival rights
decision blocked: Any EV/CLV/ROI claim or originated line comparison

decision question: Which competitions, markets, operators, jurisdictions and seasons are in scope?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: Official NFL schedule and stats pages are league event/stat references
missing information required: Competition and market list; jurisdiction/operator access; pre/postgame cutoff; postseason handling

decision question: What does “originate my own lines” mean operationally?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: Not answered by NFL schedule or stats pages
missing information required: Probability forecast plus fair price or spread/total distribution; vig treatment; price granularity; update cadence; publish/internal use distinction

decision question: How will the system identify actual starters and second/third/fourth replacements for each offensive and defensive unit?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: NFL injury report presents player position injury practice status and game status
missing information required: Authorized dated depth/lineup source, transaction records, role identity and historical game participation/snap data

decision question: How will injury information be time-stamped without inferring health from blanks?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: NFL report has injury and practice/game status fields
missing information required: Historical report snapshots, update times and source corrections; policy for blank status and late scratches

decision question: Which outcome definitions and settlement rules govern each line and prop?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: NFL official game center provides game results and linked gamebooks
missing information required: Market-specific push/void/OT rules, stat corrections, ties, player participation and operator settlement

decision question: What is the minimum evidence horizon, walk-forward schedule and candidate freeze policy?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: Official methodology guidance warns against evaluating on training data and against test-set tuning leakage
missing information required: Pre-registered time splits, feature cutoff, holdout period, sample-size/power method and unblinding rule

decision question: What is the proper parlay model for same-game and cross-game combinations?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: SciPy defines Pearson correlation and bootstrap methods; they do not supply NFL correlations
missing information required: Joint-event observations by market pair and synchronized licensed odds/payouts; slate-level resampling design
decision blocked: Any probability product or parlay score

decision question: What are the operator limits, stake assumptions, transaction costs and price availability?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: No verified operator price feed or market execution data is configured
missing information required: Executable price/limits, account restrictions, bet availability, stake sizing and cost/slippage rules

decision question: Will leaderboard rewards be cash, prizes, credits, status or research priority only?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: Canadian federal and Alberta gaming sources are relevant starting points; no legal classification is made here
missing information required: Alberta and all entrant jurisdictions; sponsor; entry consideration; chance vs skill design; eligibility/age; official rules; tax; dispute/audit process; counsel signoff
decision blocked: Any prize with monetary or material value

decision question: What objective should rank research strategies without rewarding variance or tiny samples?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: A holdout/test separation is supported by general ML methodology; no outcome data exist here
missing information required: Frozen scoring formula, minimum eligible volume, uncertainty method, strategy family correction, stake/return definition and tie rules

decision question: What independent audit and fraud controls are needed?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: NFL source and method documentation alone do not provide system governance
missing information required: Immutable predictions and timestamps, code/config hashes, independent review, corrections, conflict disclosures and manipulation policy

decision question: How will user data, account data or entrant identity be handled?
what is confirmed from reviewed sources: No user account or personal data is part of this prototype
missing information required: Whether identities are collected, retention/access controls, consent, privacy impact and cross-border hosting review
